We have K+ and Cl- likely. Need confirm with other tests maybe. Could also be AgBr (white precipitate) but dissolves in NH3? AgBr is sparingly soluble, dissolves partially in excess NH3? Usually AgBr does not dissolve in dilute NH3, only in concentrated. But here fully dissolves, suggests AgCl. So anion Cl-.

We could also test with BaCl2 to see if precipitate forms (if sulfate). But we have already evidence.

Thus final answer: K+ cation, Cl- anion.
